subject: Renewal + capacity increase — procurement steps and SOW request
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@santerahealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal notice — Term change & capacity increase request

Hi Lauren,

Quick note from Procurement at Santera: our current contract with Redwood is up for renewal on June 28. We are planning to extend the term for 12 months and increase committed capacity by ~20% based on anticipated usage.

Can you please send an updated SOW and an updated pricing quote (PDF) that reflects the term change and new committed units? Procurement also needs the steps to re-onboard Redwood into our procurement portal (we require a portal upload + vendor form) — ideally by May 23 so we can queue finance review.

I attached a draft PO intent (Santera_PO_Intent.pdf) for context. Do you have a standard procurement packet we can upload?

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Santera Health
elena.ruiz@santerahealth.com
+1 415-555-2121

Date: 2028-05-09T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal notice — Term change & capacity increase request

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the PO intent.

Looping in Aditya (AM) for pricing/SOW, Grace for onboarding/capacity, Rishi for SLA and term language, and Monica for procurement invoicing. We can provide an updated SOW + pricing and a vendor packet for portal upload.

High level proposal:
- 12 month renewal, 20% committed capacity increase (Aditya will confirm exact tier and list unit economics)
- We will draft SOW_v3 and an SLA amendment and aim to get the packet to you by EOD May 15 to meet your May 23 procurement queue.

Next steps from our side: Aditya to share pricing and SOW draft, Rishi to review SLA redlines, Grace to outline portal upload steps and what Santera will need from your side.

Would you be available for a 30-min kickoff on Tuesday May 14 (9:00–9:30 PT or 11:00–11:30 PT)?

Best,

Subject: Re: Renewal notice — Term change & capacity increase request

Thanks Lauren / Elena — I took a first pass on numbers.

Proposal notes (draft):
- Base: 12 month renewal at current committed tier.
- Capacity uplift: +20% committed units -> moves Santera into Tier 3 pricing (15% discount vs on-demand). Final unit counts TBD after usage check.
- Suggested retention credit: apply any unused burst credits from current term to the new term (we can show an itemized credit schedule).

I will attach SOW_v3.pdf to the packet and include a one-page summary for procurement that lists: new term dates, billing cadence, PO number field, and invoice contact (Monica). Grace — can you confirm whether we need any vendor certificates for the portal? Elena — please confirm if Santera requires a W9 (US) or other tax forms.

I'll aim to have the SOW draft and price summary to you by May 15.

— Aditya
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Quick redlines after scanning the current contract and Elena's ask:
- SLA: propose a limited amendment to the SLA to reflect committed capacity and priority queueing for dedicated runs. I attached a tracked-change doc (redwood-sla-amendment.docx).
- Term: 12 months, auto-renew opt-out 60 days prior to anniversary.
- Credits: we will keep the existing credit schedule; Aditya please list carried credits.

Rough turnaround: I can finalize redlines within 24 business hours once Aditya posts SOW_v3. If legal needs to cut anything tighter, flag it and we'll prioritize.

Rishi Malhotra

Redwood Inference

5) Fill PO number field and confirm invoice cadence (monthly in arrears).

DocuSign link (for term signature): https://docusign.com/redwood/RDW-2034-SOW

Available times for a 30-min kickoff: Tuesday May 16 at 9:00 PT or Wednesday May 17 at 11:00 PT. Let us know which works and we will send an invite.

Thanks — we tried to keep the amendments minimal to speed through procurement.
